title: Transporting Quantiles to Codebook: Scalable Vector Quantization without Codebook Collapse
abstract: arXiv:2610.34828v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Effective discrete representation learning with VQ-VAE serves as a fundamental component of modern autoregressive generative models. However, it is widely known to suffer from codebook collapse and inefficient code utilization. To address this issue, we propose FlowVQ, a simple yet effective alternative to standard vector quantization by formulating neural quantization as a joint modeling and clustering process. Specifically, we learn the latent space using a lightweight flow matching model alongside training, corresponding to a probability flow ODE that transports an often fixed well-behaved source distribution while preserving probability mass. Based on this, we define the codebook C_1 by transporting even-quantile partitioned prior codes C_0 from the source space through the learned flow, and obtaining the Voronoi centroids under the induced distribution, leading to a structured discretization. translated_title: 将分位数输运至码本：无码本坍缩的可扩展向量量化
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.34828v1 公告类型：新 摘要：基于VQ-VAE的有效离散表示学习是现代自回归生成模型的基础组成部分。然而，众所周知，它普遍存在码本坍缩和码本利用率低下的问题。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了FlowVQ，这是一种简单而有效的标准向量量化替代方案，它将神经量化表述为联合建模与聚类的过程。具体而言，我们在训练的同时使用一个轻量级的流匹配模型来学习潜在空间，其对应于一个概率流常微分方程（ODE），该方程在保持概率质量的同时，将一个通常固定且性质良好的源分布进行输运。基于此，我们通过学习到的流将源空间中按均匀分位数划分的先验码C_0进行输运，从而定义码本C_1，并在诱导分布下获得Voronoi质心，进而实现结构化的离散化。我们在图像标记化任务上进行了评估……
tldr: 提出FlowVQ方法，将向量量化表述为联合建模与聚类过程，通过流匹配模型将均匀分位数划分的先验码输运至潜在空间生成Voronoi质心以构建码本，从而实现无码本坍缩且码本利用率高的可扩展向量量化。
en_tdlr: FlowVQ formulates neural quantization as a joint modeling and clustering process, transporting evenly-quantile-partitioned prior codes through a learned flow matching model to construct the codebook via Voronoi centroids, achieving scalable vector quantization without codebook collapse.
